faces.transcription: Open Door 44. Place a Control Center sticker on the target city. Then place the sticker sheet in the reserve (do not put a bug on the center). Move the target City card under the objective to the Player discard pile.
faces.flavor: The Soviets kept the location of the control center well-hidden during its construction. Unfortunately, it's now under heavy guard; bugging it will be difficult.
